name: Powerlifter: 12-week block, own squat/bench/deadlift program, zero cardio
story: 26 y/o. Mon/Wed/Fri evenings 90 min, Sunday 2 h. Full gym. Runs their own program (entered as routines).

routines.name: Squat day
routines.dsl: Gym: Back Squat 5x3 @ RPE 8 | Pause Squat 3x4 @ RPE 7 | Superset: Leg Curl 3x10 + Hanging Leg Raises 3x12

routines.name: Bench day
routines.dsl: Gym: Bench Press 5x3 @ RPE 8 | Close-Grip Bench 3x6 @ RPE 7 | Superset: Barbell Row 4x8 + Face Pulls 3x15

routines.name: Deadlift day
routines.dsl: Gym: Deadlift 5x2 @ RPE 8 | Deficit Deadlift 3x4 @ RPE 7 | Superset: Pull-ups 3x8 + Ab Wheel 3x10

routines.name: Accessories & weak points
routines.dsl: Gym: Overhead Press 4x6 @ RPE 7 | Superset: Dumbbell Row 3x10 + Dips 3x10 | Superset: Back Extension 3x12 + Plank Hold 3x1
